description: This file contains mock implementations of various Cosa API functions used for testing purposes. It declares external mock objects and defines functions that delegate calls to the mock object, primarily to facilitate unit testing by simulating Cosa API behaviors.

classes.name: CosaMock
classes.description: A mock class simulating the Cosa API for testing purposes.

methods.name: bool Cosa_Init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the Cosa mock; returns false if g_cosaMock is null.

methods.name: void Cosa_Shutdown(void)
methods.description: Shuts down the Cosa mock, does nothing if g_cosaMock is null.

methods.name: bool Cosa_FindDestComp(char * pObjName,char ** ppDestComponentName,char ** ppDestComponentPath)
methods.description: Finds destination component, delegates call to mock if available.

methods.name: bool Cosa_GetParamValues(char * pDestComponentName,char * pDestComponentPath,char ** pParamArray,int uParamSize,int * puValueSize,parameterValStruct_t *** pppValueArray)
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values, delegates to mock if available.

methods.name: void Cosa_FreeParamValues(int uSize,parameterValStruct_t ** ppValueArray)
methods.description: Frees parameter values, delegates to mock if available.

ctags.name: Cosa_GetParamValues
ctags.signature: (char * pDestComponentName,char * pDestComponentPath,char ** pParamArray,int uParamSize,int * puValueSize,parameterValStruct_t *** pppValueArray)
